text: There were two parrots in a tree in the forest. Titu and Mithu. Titu was very intelligent and hardworking. Mithu was very lazy. He used to postpone everything. Let's see how Titu comes to his nest with the grass in his beak. He sees Mithu sleeping on the branch. Mithu, are you still taking rest? It's going to rain. Fix your nest quickly. Otherwise, how will you save yourself from the water? Yes, I will. What's the hurry? It's going to rain soon. I'll see when it rains. Let me take rest now. Kittu, what happened to my child? I was trying to climb the tree with my beak. I slipped and fell.
